name: John Wick Chapter 3 Parabellum
description: In this third installment of the adrenaline-fueled action franchise, skilled assassin John Wick (Keanu Reeves) returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin's guild, the High Table,…

name: Brick Mansions
description: An undercover Detroit cop navigates a dangerous neighborhood that's surrounded by a containment wall with the help of an ex-con in order to bring down a crime lord and his plot to devastate the entire city.

name: Rain Man
description: Charles Sanford \"Charlie\" Babbit is a self-centered Los Angeles-based automobile dealer/hustler/bookie who is at war with his own life. Charlie, as a young teenager, used his father's 1948 Buick convertible without permission and as a result, he went to jail for two days on account that his father reported it stolen. It is then that Charlie learns that his estranged father died and left him from his last will and testament a huge bed of roses and the car while the remainder will of $3 Million goes into a trust fund to be distributed to someone. Charlie seemed pretty angry by this and decides to look into this matter. It seems as if that \"someone\" is Raymond, Charlie's unknown brother, an autistic savant who lives in a world of his own, resides at the Walbrook Institute. Charlie then kidnaps Raymond and decides to take him on a lust for life trip to the west coast as a threat to get the $3 Million inheritance. Raymond's acts and nagging, including repeated talks of \"Abbott & Costello\", \"Four minutes till Wapner\" and refusal to fly on an airline except Quantas drives Charlie insane... and out of his selfish world into a cross-country

name: Pollyanna
description: A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.

name: The Sex Addict 2017
description: When a PhD student decides to document a real life sex addict for her dissertation in sex psychology, she becomes much more than a curious observer.

name: The Matrix
description: Thomas A. Anderson is a man living two lives. By day he is an average computer programmer and by night a hacker known as Neo. Neo has always questioned his reality, but the truth is far beyond his imagination. Neo finds himself targeted by the police when he is contacted by Morpheus, a legendary computer hacker branded a terrorist by the government. Morpheus awakens Neo to the real world, a ravaged wasteland where most of humanity have been captured by a race of machines that live off of the humans' body heat and electrochemical energy and who imprison their minds within an artificial reality known as the Matrix. As a rebel against the machines, Neo must return to the Matrix and confront the agents: super-powerful computer programs devoted to snuffing out Neo and the entire human rebellion.

name: Robosapien Rebooted
description: The story begins when a scientist is working on an intelligent robot for humanitarian purposes, who discovers the company he works for is intends to use the robots for military purposes. The scientist steals one of the robots which ends up being lost and broken, then is fixed by a lonely 11-year-old boy. A robot boy and a human boy team up to save their respective parents, who are being held captive by the organization that funded the robot's creator. The two become friends and embark on adventures while being pursued by the authorities.

name: Sappy Holiday
description: When a sous chef accidentally discovers her boyfriend is going to propose to her on Christmas Eve, she begins doubting their future together; especially when a handsome maple farmer rescues her from a snowstorm.

name: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
description: Lorelei and Dorothy are just \"Two Little Girls from Little Rock\", lounge singers on a transatlantic cruise, working their way to Paris, and enjoying the company of any eligible men they might meet along the way, even though \"Diamonds are a Girl's Best Friend.\" Based on the Broadway musical based on the novel.

name: After the Dark
description: At an international school in Jakarta, a philosophy teacher challenges his class of twenty graduating seniors to choose which ten of them would take shelter underground and reboot the human race in the event of a nuclear apocalypse.

name: Dark Shadows
description: In the year 1752, Joshua and Naomi Collins, with young son Barnabas, set sail from Liverpool, England to start a new life in America. But even an ocean was not enough to escape the mysterious curse that has plagued their family. Two decades pass and Barnabas (Johnny Depp) has the world at his feet-or at least the town of Collinsport, Maine. The master of Collinwood Manor, Barnabas is rich, powerful and an inveterate playboy...until he makes the grave mistake of breaking the heart of Angelique Bouchard (Eva Green). A witch, in every sense of the word, Angelique dooms him to a fate worse than death: turning him into a vampire, and then burying him alive. Two centuries later, Barnabas is inadvertently freed from his tomb and emerges into the very changed world of 1972. He returns to Collinwood Manor to find that his once-grand estate has fallen into ruin. The dysfunctional remnants of the Collins family have fared little better, each harboring their own dark secrets. Matriarch Elizabeth Collins Stoddard (Michelle Pfeiffer) has called upon live-in psychiatrist, Dr. Julia Hoffman (Helena Bonham Carter), to help with her family troubles.

name: Ride Along
description: Fast-talking security guard Ben joins his cop brother-in-law James on a 24-hour patrol of Atlanta in order to prove himself worthy of marrying Angela, James' sister.

name: Assassin 1986
description: A retired Agent from an Intelligence Agency is contacted by the Agency in order to stop an ultra-secret robot that is killing some government officials. That will be not an easy task, because the robot looks human and it was specifically built to be an efficient killer, not to mention that it is…

name: Hulk
description: Bruce Banner, a brilliant scientist with a cloudy past about his family, is involved in an accident in his laboratory causing him to become exposed to gamma radiation and Nanomeds (A tiny life-form that is supposed to heal wounds but has killed everything with which they have made contact). Confused and curious about his survival, Banner discovers that since the accident, whenever he becomes angry he transforms into a giant green monster destroying everything in sight in an act of fury. Bruce's mysterious past and the answer to why the radiation had this effect becomes revealed to him as his Birth Father David Banner intervenes with hopes to continue experimenting on him.

name: Donovans Brain
description: Dr. Patrick \"Pat\" J. Cory is researching brains with his assistant and friend Dr. Frank Schratt and his wife Janice Cory through experiments with monkeys in a laboratory in his house. When an airplane crashes nearby his house, there is only one near-death survivor, the millionaire Warren H. Donovan…

name: Back in Action
description: The sister of a former U.S. Green Beret, is involved in a love affair with a mobster, endangering seriously her life. His brother will make his best efforts to save her from her boyfriend and his friends, fighting with or without external help. But perhaps this tough cop, Rossi, could help him...

name: Beti No. 1
description: Durga Devi has three sons, Ram, Laxman and Bharat. She wants a heir to carry the family name forward. Ram and Laxman are married and have so far only produced girls, much to their mother's disgust. So when Bharat marries Priya, she is expecting them to have a son. But Priya delivers a baby girl. Anticipating the mother's anger, they hide the gender of the child initially, and subsequently; switch their child with another male child, thus giving rise to more conflicts.

name: Sky High
description: It all begins when young Will Stronghold, the son of the two famous superheroes: Steve and Josie, A.K.A. the incredibly strong, seemingly invulnerable Commander and and the high-speed flying Jetstream. However, Will does not actually know if he has any powers of his own, and has not told his parents this. He and his best friend, Layla are facing their first day of a secret school in the clouds like none on earth: Sky High, the first and only high school for kids with super-human powers going through crime-fighting puberty. But with no apparent superpowers of his own, however, Will seems destined to grow up a mere sidekick. But as he discovers his true strengths, he'll also learn that it takes loyalty and teamwork to truly become a hero!

name: Beauty and the Beast 2017
description: An adaptation of the fairy tale about a monstrous-looking prince and a young woman who fall in love.

name: Waiting
description: Shiv and Tara support each other while their partners are healing at the hospital.

name: Triple Threat
description: A hit contract is taken out on a billionaires daughter intent on bringing down a major crime syndicate. A down and out team of mercenaries must take on a group of professional assassins and stop them before they kill their target.

name: A Long Way Down
description: Four people meet on New Year's Eve and form a surrogate family to help one another weather the difficulties of their lives.

name: The Girl with All the Gifts
description: A scientist and a teacher living in a dystopian future embark on a journey of survival with a special young girl named Melanie.

name: Footloose 1984
description: Classic tale of teenage rebellion and repression features a delightful combination of dance choreography and realistic and touching performances. When teenager Ren McCormack and his family move from big-city Chicago to a small Midwestern town, he's in for a real case of culture shock. Though he…

name: Hellraiser: Hellseeker
description: A couple, Trevor and Kirsty, are in an accident when their car goes off a bridge. Trevor wakes in a hospital weeks later and learns that Kirsty's body has not been found though she is presumed dead. He also learns that police suspect him of being a murderer. Then Pinhead, a Cenobite, reveals to him that in reality, Kirsty is still alive, and he is being punished for cheating on her throughout their marriage. Trevor had forced Kirsty to open the puzzle box in hopes the Cenobites would take her away, but she made a bargain in which she offered them five souls. Kirsty pins four murders on Trevor and makes him the fifth victim. He was the lone person in the car accident.

name: Sidekicks
description: Barry lives with his single father in Texas and is having a rough time of it. Asthmatic, Barry cannot participate in sports and the school bully and his gym teacher torment him about it. Barry daydreams about being a martial arts expert like Chuck Norris and decides to learn karate. After some initial difficulties he finds Mr. Lee who teaches him karate and Barry gets good enough to consider entering a team in a competition. When he finds himself short one team mate at the competition, who should come out of the stands to help him but Chuck Norris.

name: Bones
description: Bones follows the exploits of a forensic anthropologist, Temperance Brennan, also known by the nickname Bones, and Special Agent Seeley Booth of the FBI. Working together, they handle difficult cases that frequently present them with unconventional physical evidence, primarily human remains that are no longer suited to tradition methods of identification. Brennan's team of eccentric, but brilliant scientists assist them in the investigations and offer unique insights into gripping, dynamic cases and into their personal lives. Although they clash in the beginning because of their different personalities, over the course of time, Brennan and Booth become close allies, friends, and more.

name: Feed the Beast
description: Feed the Beast is a television show that follows the journey of two friends, Tommy and Dion, as they attempt to open up a Greek restaurant in the Bronx. Though this has long been a dream of theirs, the pair's culinary goals are undermined by Dion's ties to the criminal underworld. As the season progresses, they are forced to deal with mobsters, small time criminals, and perhaps the most frightening foe of them all: the New York restaurant world.

name: Six Feet Under
description: Fisher and Sons Funeral Home in Los Angeles is family operated. When patriarch Nathaniel Fisher Sr. unexpectedly dies as his recently purchased hearse collides with a bus, his family struggles to continue the business. Eldest son Nate has a habit of running from duty while middle son David, serious and responsible, takes over the bulk of management while wrestling with his own issues. Younger sister Claire is a troubled teenager at odds with the world, trying to get through her high school years. Tense and unhappy Ruth, the matriarch of the family once accustomed to her housewife fate, now spreads her wings in directions she never dared while her husband was still alive. Through Nathaniel's death, this unique family will discover the importance of living.

name: Sideways
description: Miles Raymond wants more out of life, but he doesn't know how to get what he wants. Facing rejection after rejection when it comes to his writing, he agrees to spend a week touring the wine country in California with his best friend Jack. The trip takes place the week before Jack's marriage, and Miles promises the other man's future wife that he will look after him. Though Miles loves wine and the finer things in life, Jack seemingly only cares about enjoying his last little bit of freedom. When the two arrive at a winery, Jack arranges a double date for the two. While Miles looks forward to the date, he also wants to make sure that his friend doesn't do something he regrets. That simple date sets up the premise for the film, as Miles finds himself in trouble thanks to the actions of his friend. As the story unfolds, viewers begin wondering if Miles will ever find the happiness he deserves and if Jack will ever receive the comeuppance that he needs.

name: Dead Man's Hand
description: Dead Man's Hand is a 2023 Western film about a newly married gunfighter named Reno who seeks a quiet life with his bride. When Reno kills a bandit in self-defense, he finds them both pulled back into his old ways. Clarence Bishop, the corrupt mayor of their locale, will not let his brother's death go unpunished. Reno must use all of his skills to protect his family and his newfound peace.

name: The Outsider
description: Lex Walker is a British military contractor. His daughter doesn't live with him, and when he's contacted to identify her body, he's heartbroken. He heads to Los Angeles to identify her body as requested. In a stunning twist, he discovers the body isn't hers. The dead person is not his daughter. Walker begins to investigate the circumstances surrounding the body in the morgue. Who is the girl in the morgue? Why was he called to identify her? The biggest question of all Walker wants answered; where is his daughter?

name: The Offer
description: Based on the wild experience The Godfather producer had while working on the classic early 1970s mob drama, the film explores the infighting and other challenges faced to get the movie to the big screen. Faced with threats and and unsavory deals from real-life mafioso families, The Godfather is the movie that almost wasn't made. The Offer explores every aspect of the filming, writing, producing, and the characters behind it. Some of the peculiar occurrences were real \"life and death\" situations.

name: The Outsider
description: A railroad worker named Jing travels to a small country town in hopes to find his American dream. Instead, he finds himself living in a nightmare when a tragedy strikes too close to home. Jing teams up with a former cop in attempts to eliminate the corruption. After setting his sights on revenge, he finds that the town is run by a group of men that have declared themselves as the rule of law. He must now choose between honoring his family and fighting for justice against a marshal who will stop at nothing to keep control of his town.

name: That Dirty Black Bag
description: In the dusty former gold town of Greenvale, where only a few citizens remain after the mines and the water dried up, a series of events are about to occur that will change everyone's lives: A wealthy local attempts to force the last farmers and ranchers to sell their land in the hope that he might find a rare vein of gold. A brothel madam attempts to negotiate water rights with those who maintain control over the last supply. A seemingly incorruptible sheriff, Arthur McCoy, clashes with a bounty hunter named Red Bill. The latter is a man who becomes well-known in the region for his reserved speech, dirty physical appearance and a black bag that bleeds blood and attracts flies for the dead.

name: 200 Cigarettes
description: Elements of comedy and drama define a story line that is based on a 1981 New Year's Eve party in New York City. A group of friends and complete strangers in their twenties go out to celebrate the New Year while reflecting on issues such as love and careers. Sexual tension, awkward dates and other relationship related problems define the humor in the plot. A party that was originally planned for a few close friends turns into an event that attracts complete strangers from all over the city. Monica, who hosts the party, is taken by surprise as more and more people rush into her out of control event. Excessive drinking and silly behavior make all of the adult characters realize how immature they are.

name: Born to Be King
description: Hollywood is filled with legendary tales of stars and starlets at war with each other--on stage and off. However, life gets interesting when a Hollywood starlet, at war with her co-star, begins to fall for a film extra who bears an uncanny resemblance to the co-star that she can't get along with. Is her attraction to the film-extra genuine or is it somehow motivated by a hidden desire to get even with her co-star?

name: The Duel
description: In the town of Helena, nothing is what it seems to be. A charismatic man known as The Preacher has convinced his town that he may have supernatural powers. Meanwhile, the Texas ranger who's been dispatched to dispose of him has his own score to settle. The Preacher was responsible for his father's death. In this battle of wits and physical might, The Preacher and the ranger put everything they love on the line to defeat one another.

name: The Equalizer 2
description: Vigilante Robert McCall is continuing his life of helping ordinary citizens find justice in everyday situations before a close friend of his is murdered by a mysterious group of criminals for seemingly no reason. The plot shifts as he then makes it his goal to find out what happened to his friend and deliver justice on her behalf, sending him on a wild goose chase to figure out who these people are, why they would harm his friend, and if there is still time for justice to prevail.

name: Last Vegas
description: Billy, Sam, Paddy and Archie have been best friends ever since they were children. Now that they are in their 60s, their friendship is just as strong as ever, and they are keen to celebrate a significant change in their group. Sworn bachelor Billy is getting married to a woman half his age, so a bachelor party is in order. The four pals decide to hit Las Vegas to celebrate the last member of their quartet finally getting hitched. It sounds like a great chance to revert to their youthful ways and have a blast, but they soon discover that Las Vegas has changed, and so have they. Their voyage of self-discovery is filled with fun and raucous shenanigans as they tear up the town.

name: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: Freddie Mercury leads Queen to become one of the greatest rock bands in history. The unique band has unprecedented success despite Freddie's hectic life choices. Then Freddie becomes tragically ill with a terminal disease. He gives his all at a performance for Live Aid, which will go down in history as one of the most memorable music events of all time. Even after Freddie's early death, Queen will go on to inspire millions of people.

name: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star
description: Bucky is a buck-toothed rural Iowa yokel with a simple mind who makes the shocking discovery that his conservative, quiet parents were both major figures in the 1970s adult film industry. He's spurred on by this bizarre revelation to make his way to Hollywood and follow their path on the road to dirty-movie dominance; however, his amazingly small male endowment is not his only impediment on the road to stardom in the field of smut.

name: Child of God
description: In the rough terrain of Sevier County, Tennessee lives Lester Ballard, described as “a child of God much like yourself.” Lester is a violent man with a shadowy past who attempts to live outside the normal realms of society, not bending to social convention or law. With no family and no ties to the community, Lester has nothing to hold him to the world, so he begins to descend deeper into a life of isolation and crime, going so far as to take up residence in a cave.

name: Guest House
description: When a newly engaged couple find their dream home, they coould not be happier. However, their happiness is brought to their limits when a friend of the previous owner refuses to move out of the guest house. Along the way, the husband befriends the squatter, but eventually even that relationship goes sour and a hilarious \"turf war\" ensues between the two men. What happens after that will change all of their lives forever.

name: Amy
description: By the time Amy Winehouse was 27 years old, the singer/songwriter was a star. She soon became a legend after her death on July 13, 2011. 'Amy' explores Winehouse's thoughts about her life and success through never-before-heard tracks and never-before-seen archival footage, including studio and personal videos. It also contains past interviews with Winehouse and current ones with her family, friends, colleagues and physicians. Some people believe that the greatest musicians, the ones who produce the most heart-wrenching sounds, have to suffer while they live. Amy's personal and professional demons resulted in rare music that can never be forgotten.

name: Green Lantern Corps
description: A group of humans join the Green Lantern Corps, an alien interstellar police force that protects the universe.

name: The Kings of Summer
description: Joe Troy is a boy on the verge of adolescence eager to assert his independence, especially from his overbearing father Frank. He needs an escape from the society that is encroaching upon him, so he comes up with a brilliant plan. Together with his best friend Patrick and a boy named Biaggio who they don't know as well, he decides that he is going to spend his summer doing exactly what he pleases. The boys head for the woods, where they build a cabin with the intention of living on their own away from the prying eyes of the adults in their lives. They will have the freedom to live on their own terms in an idyllic wilderness, but their independence comes with a cost.

name: Dead Trigger
description: It's 2025. A virus of unknown origin has killed off a large portion of the population and turned another vast portion into zombies. The government must train new soldiers, known as Dead Triggers, regularly to combat this plague since these soldiers have the lowest life expectancy of any units in the military. The latest group of recruits, led by Captain Kyle Walker and Captain Rockstock, have their training cut short after the government loses contact with a group of scientists who have been trying to create a cure. The team is ordered to enter Terminal City, ground zero for the plague, to find answers. What awaits them in the city is far more horrifying than they ever imagined...

name: Never Back Down
description: A high school student, Jake, who is pulled from Iowa to Florida by his brother's budding tennis career. Jake doesn't do well in the new school right away because he has a short temper, but he is introduced to Mixed Martial Arts by a new friend, Max. Jake is introduced to a local gym, where his anger proves to be too much in the beginning. Jake's main competitor, Ryan, views a video where Jake wins a backalley skirmish and challenges Jake to an MMA competition. Ryan is the champion of this underground fighting match. Jake initially says no until Ryan brutally beats Max and leaves him at Jake's door. Jake accepts the invitation to fight and winds up beating Ryan in the parking lot. He wins the respect of everyone at school, including Ryan.

name: Siberia
description: When a diamond merchant from America travels to Siberia to find a buyer for a collection of blue diamonds with rare and mysterious origins, he becomes tangled in an affair with the owner of a small Siberian cafe. The more obsessive his affair becomes, the more the dangerous world of the Russian diamond trade intrudes upon his life, until eventually it seems there is no way out for either him or his lover. Both his relationship and the diamonds are soon in so much danger that all he can hope for is to find a way out.

name: The Vietnam War
description: \"The Vietnam War\" is a multi-part documentary gets into the details of this Southeast Asia conflict which took place between 1964 and 1975. The program delves into the early days of planning under the Kennedy administration, escalation during the mid-60s, incursions into nearby Laos and Cambodia, and the after-effects on soldiers, politicians, and citizens of both the U.S. and Vietnam. \"The Vietnam War\" also looks into the domestic side of the conflict with the numerous protests and anger which enflamed the population of the U.S. during this period.

name: Trainspotting
description: A group of Scottish friends finds solace from their depressing lives in heroin. In a spell of virtue, Mark decides to go clean. He finds himself in hot water when he scores with a pretty girl named Diane, only to find that she is underage. Mark and his friends continue on a downward spiral of heroin addiction, causing a horrible tragedy. As bad luck dogs the friends, Mark decides it's time to get out. But shaking his dependence on the drug and his friends may be harder than he thinks.

name: Nancy Drew
description: Nancy Drew is not an ordinary girl. Solving crimes with her deductive reasoning, she leaves her River Heights home with her father and temporarily lives in California. Because her father was busy with work, Nancy decides on the rental home. Belonging to a murdered movie star, Dehlia Draycott, Nancy begins to investigate the decades old murder. With new friends in tow, she unravels the mystery and finds that many of her father's colleagues are involved. While she secretly researches the Draycott's life, Nancy's father is insisting that she act like a normal teenager. Torn between her talented hobby and her father's wishes, Nancy tries to take both in stride as Draycott's murderer comes to light. As her friends rally around her, along with a boyfriend that shows up from River Heights, Nancy is in for the mystery of her life.

name: Donnie Darko
description: Donnie is an eclectic teen who enjoys challenging authority. On occasion, Donnie is visited by a monstrous rabbit. During these visits, the rabbit urges Donnie to pull dangerous pranks on those around him. On one particular visit, the creature informs Donnie that the world will end in one month. While trying to understand this prophecy, Donnie must also deal with his dysfunctional family. In the final hours, havoc explodes all around him. Many of the local teens, and Donnie himself, do not survive.

name: Brickleberry
description: A National Park is about to be shut down, and the group of goofy forest rangers who work there are not able to stop this from happening. However, a new ranger comes in with the purpose of helping to save the park and transforming these ne'er do well forest rangers into ones who can actually keep this park running. They get into many different situations while they are working in the park, and each one has a unique life story that makes for some very funny predicaments. Together, they may or may not be able to save the National Park.

name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: Harry Potter is a young British orphan who attends Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he discovers new friends and plenty of adventures. Along with the Hogwarts Headmaster, Albus Dumbledore, Harry becomes close to a wizard and witch in his school house of Griffandore, Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger. The three friends soon find themselves involved in a mystery as it seems someone wants to hurt Harry. Although Harry suspects that Professor Severus Snape is the one trying to harm him, he finds out that Professor Quirrell, acting under the direction of Lord Voldemort, is the wizard who's actually attempting to kill him. With help from his friends, Harry is able to defeat Quirrell, but Voldemort's fate is left up to question, leaving Harry to wonder if he's truly safe.

name: Boogie
description: Alfred 'Boogie' Chin is a teenager from Queens whose amazing basketball skills are good enough to land a scholarship with a major university. He has the potential to make it all the way to the pros and become one of the few Asian stars in the NBA. But Boogie's life, family and girlfriend are throwing up a lot of obstacles. Boogie can be his own worst enemy with a bad attitude and chip on his shoulder. He clashes with his coach, parents and rival players as he juggles playing hard on the court with navigating the game of life.

name: Red Hook Summer
description: Flik Royale is a subdued youngster who’s traveled from Atlanta to the housing projects of Red Hook to spend the summer with his grandfather, Bishop Enoch Rouse. The Bishop is a deeply religious man, and wastes no time trying to convert his young grandson. Just when Flik is convinced that his summer will be nothing but disaster and disappointment, he meets Chazz Morningstar, a young girl who makes an effort to show him what Brooklyn is really about. Between Chazz and Bishop Enoch, Flik realizes that he is a pretty lucky young man after all.

1923 follows the Duttons, a wealthy ranching family in Montana, as they face a new set of challenges in the early 20th century, including the rise of Western expansion, Prohibition, and the Great Depression. The series is set in the fictional town of Roarke, Montana, and is based on the real-life Duttons, who were one of the most powerful families in the region. The series explores the Duttons' complex relationships with each other, as well as their interactions with the Native Americans, the sheepherders, and the newcomers who are flocking to Montana in search of a new life.

name: Marnie
description: Marnie Edgar is a cunning thief with a deep distrust of men. She is plagued by her strong fear of the color red and thunderstorms. She uses her natural beauty and charm to steal money. Marnie meets the handsome Mark Rutland, a customer of Sidney Strutt, her recent robbery victim. Mark hires Marnie in spite of knowing she's a thief. Mark strikes up a relationship with Marnie and falls in love. Marnie steals from his company and leaves. He tracks her down and blackmails her into marrying him. Mark becomes obsessed with uncovering the reason for her behavior. He finds out that Marnie has a deep, dark secret buried within her mind. The only way to heal her is to get her to face her shocking past.

name: Antebellum
description: Veronica Henley is no stranger to mysteries. She's one of the most celebrated mystery writers in print. Henley is known for her realism and her ability to terrify readers, but things are about to become a little too real. Veronica finds herself caught up in a world straight out of her books, one that becomes a legitimate nightmare. She will have to use all of her skills as a writer and a would-be detective to survive the horrors that await.

name: Deadpool 3
description: The third installment in the Deadpool franchise.

name: Keeping the Faith
description: Brian, Jake and Anna were childhood friends. While Jake and Brian have remained close despite the fact that Jake is a Rabbi and Brian is a Catholic priest, they lose touch with Anna until she resurfaces in their lives years later, when they are young adults. Each of them must examine what he really believes and wants out of life, as her arrival throws them into a tizzy.Both find themselves falling in love with their old friend, which introduces tension into their friendship with each other. What's more, Brian can't be in a romantic relationship at all as a priest, and Jake is pretty sure that he would be ostracized for having a girlfriend who isn't Jewish. Anna, meanwhile, feels rather torn between them.

name: Autumn in New York
description: Middle-aged playboy Will Keane likes to chase, catch and date beautiful women. Unfortunately, he has commitment issues that eventually ends even the most promising of relationships. When a girl in her 20s named Charlotte Fielding comes into his life, he begins to work his charm on her. Soon, they begin having passionate relationship with unexpected consequences. When Will learns Charlotte is ill, they both take an unexpected journey of heartache, true love and unforgettable life lessons.

name: Up All Night
description: A busy TV talk show producer and her stay-at-home husband grapple with the challenges of having a baby while trying to maintain balance between their personal lives and their new responsibilities caring for their newborn. Throw into the mix the needy talk show host who pre-baby relied on her producer for everything, including emotional support for her messed-up love life. Besides experiencing the problems caused by lack of sleep, role reversal, and work clothes covered with baby spit-up, the couple finds it nearly impossible to maintain their friendships on the same level they had pre-baby. When Mom begins missing out on her child's milestones, and Dad starts feeling cut off from the world, they begin to re-examine the modern parenting arrangement they chose.

name: The Wilde Wedding
description: A retired movie star celebrates her fourth wedding with her dysfunctional family and friends, several of whom are also famous. Her teen granddaughter films the happenings of the weekend for a 'documentary.' The movie is packed with characters and plot lines. The bride's first ex-husband is still infatuated with her, and her husband-to-be is trying to tame his womanizing ways. Various characters find new sexual and romantic entanglements and complicate the family relationships.

name: Iron Will
description: Will Stoneman may only be a teenager, but he has had to take on the role of head of the family due to his father’s untimely death. It is a struggle to help his mother maintain their land in Canada, but they two usually manage to scrape by. When the expenses continue to rise, he decides he will take his father’s sled dogs and enter a cross country sled race. He is discouraged from everyone participating, and because he is younger and inexperience, he often finds he must work longer hours and survive of smaller amount of food and sleep to be competitive.

name: Heart of Champions
description: Set in 1999, an Ivy League college hires an army vet as the coach of their problematic rowing team after they finished last place at the national championship. The school has high hopes for these individuals and wants to push them towards the Olympic spotlight. This army vet is their last hope to resolve the constant fights amongst team members and help these young men reach their full potential. With his unconventional training methods and his experience in the army, the Army veteran inspires the young men to conquer their personal demons and learn what it takes to be team players and champions.

name: Turbo: A Power Rangers Movie
description: The evil space pirate queen Divatox has homed in on the wizard Lerigot on a faraway world with one goal in mind: to steal his trans-dimensional golden key and use it to travel to another plane and unite with the demon Maligore. The wizard narrowly escapes and teleports himself to Earth in search of the robot Alpha 5 and his master, Zordon. Sensing Lerigot's distress, Zordon summons the Power Rangers from Angel Grove to his chamber with a mission to seek the wizard in Africa, which unfolds into an explosive conflict with Divatox and her evil minions.

name: Drift
description: When they're not helping their seamstress mother keep their 1960s household together with manual labor, Jimmy and Andy Kelly focus on riding the waves in their hometown. They meet a free-spirited freelance photographer named J.B. and his friend Lani and decide that the best way to win some financial stability would be to set up a surf gear shop. The brothers and their friends have some unfriendly waters to traverse in getting their business set up, however, as local bankers are uncooperative and an intimidating criminal seems intent on harassing the boys into giving up.

name: Rust Creek
description: In the thriller Rust Creek, college senior Sawyer Scott is an overachieving student who gets lost after making a wrong turn while making her way to a job interview. After an unfortunate sequence of events left her fleeing a pair of attackers, she found herself disoriented in dense forest and needing to trust an inscrutable loner with questionable intentions at best. With serious injuries limiting her ability to escape, she must rely on him, hoping he remains devoted to protecting her from the previous attackers who waged a search for her.

name: Edtv
description: Ed is a normal guy until cameras invade his life. An ambitious TV producer, Cynthia, thinks Ed is perfect for a reality show that simply follows his daily life. Starting out with boring content, Cynthia isn't sure if Ed is right for the part, until his brother, Ray, makes a startling confession. Cheating on his girlfriend, Shari, Ray breaks up with her as Ed tries to smooth the relationship over. However, Ed has secret feelings for Shari that she apparently shares as they kiss on live television. At the insistence of Cynthia, Ed and Shari play their love affair on live television, but the stress of the spotlight causes the pair to fight. With beautiful Hollywood women ready to whisk Ed away, Shari must find a way to keep Ed without the spotlight's glare forcing them apart.

name: RoboCop 3
description: A huge company named Omni Consumer Products is determined to make their featured project, Delta City, happen. This company faces road blocks when the occupants of the homes needed for this project won't move. Omni Consumer Products decides to intimidate these occupants by hiring an unsympathetic army to pressure them to change their minds. When things heat up and sides need to be taken, Robocop has the difficult task of deciding which side he is on.

name: The Good Boss
description: The leader of a business that makes industrial scales sets off to convince his employees that they are one family. This happens as he awaits a visit that could see him earn an award for excellence. His words seem true when he helps the son of a long-time employee to secure a job after he is arrested for beating an immigrant. However, it later becomes clear that his actions are in self-interest. He only wants to portray an image of brotherhood to the judges.

name: Mortal Kombat
description: The evil realm of the Outworld holds a martial arts tournament once every 20 years for the right to cross over to and control the Earth. Raiden, the god of lightning, serves as Earth's representative in the tournament and chooses warriors to fight for it. Raiden invites Shaolin monk Liu Kang, military officer Sonya Blade and kung fu movie star Johnny Cage to fight the forces of darkness on behalf of humanity. They must defeat Outworld overlord Shang Tsung and his champion Prince Goro in the tournament to save the Earth from invasion and enslavement.

name: Confidence
description: Jake Vig is a talented grifter who rips off an unsuspecting mark for thousands of dollars with the help of his three partners and a pair of corrupt policemen in the LAPD. When the mark and one of Jake's partners are found dead, however, he discovers that they had actually ripped off an accountant to a powerful, dangerous and idiosyncratic crime lord named Winston King. Jake decides that his and his teammates' best route is to seek penance with King by pulling off an extremely lucrative job on a banker with extensive criminal connections. With the addition of a new team member, a pickpocket named Lily, Jake and his team may have what it takes to outsmart their enemies and finally settle their accounts.

name: Article 99
description: A veteran's hospital is having problems due to an administration that is more interested in saving money than saving patients. The hospital is overcrowded and understaffed to the point that patients are suffering. A group of doctors at the hospital decide that they must do what is necessary to help their patients, even if it means circumventing the rules or just out and out breaking them. The doctors must find a way to give the patients the best care possible, despite all the bureaucracy.

name: Annabelle Comes Home
description: Annabelle, a demonic doll residing in the home of Ed and Lorraine Warren, uses her satanic deception to arouse chaos and horror. In a last-ditch effort to safeguard their family, Ed and Lorraine place Annabelle in quarantine. For added protection, Ed and Lorraine store Annabelle in a sacred glass box where she'll await the priest's arrival. In a gory turn of events, Annabelle employs her hellish tactics, making Judy, the Warrens' daughter, her next victim.

name: Mysteries of Egypt
description: Ancient Egypt was a place of mystery and rumors surrounding her past remain to this day. The pyramids of Giza are the only remaining wonder of the original seven wonders of the world, and their true age is somewhat unclear. A young girl asks her grandfather about the pyramids and ancient Egypt, which launches into a depiction of the discovery of the tomb of Tutankhamen. This was an historic event that showed the world the wealth and splendor that accompanied Egyptian royalty when they were laid to rest.

name: Peppermint
description: Riley North finds most of her life has been taken away from her after a horrific drive-by shooting at the hands of a vicious cartel. After she sees that the criminals are able to walk free due to their power within the corrupt system, Riley takes it upon herself to gain revenge. She'll go on her own personal quest to avenge those who ruined her life in this vigilante-style action thriller film.

name: Skate God
description: It's not necessarily easy to make the discovery that you've descended from a Greek god. For one skateboarder, in fact, it only manages to complicate things. Living in a dystopian society is already hard enough as it is. Now he'll have to fight with a secret society that wants to destroy everything that people hold dear. In a world where life isn't as precious as it should be, this skateboarder might need to call upon his godly wisdom if he wants to make it out alive.

name: We Don't Belong Here
description: A family prone to mental illness stands at the brink of total disaster as they deal with all of the complications of modern life. As the mother struggles to pick up the pieces and define a new normal, her children are spiraling wildly out of control. When the son finds himself entrenched with drug dealers and other unsavory characters, it seems as if the entire situation may completely unravel and his mom may be powerless to stop the hands of fate.

name: Bend It Like Beckham
description: Jesminder Bhamra, called Jess to her friends, is a young Indian woman who lives in London. Her traditional Indian family does not understand her obsession with football (soccer) and won’t allow her to play. However, Jess has an Anglo friend names Jules who convinces her to try out for the local women’s team for which she plays. The two girls cement their friendship as Jess becomes a wonderful asset to the team. They struggle for a time with the fact that they both have a crush on their coach. Things become more complicated when Jess’ family realizes she’s been playing against their wishes. Many things come to a head at the huge, traditional Indian wedding that Jess’ family gives her sister.

name: A Christmas Carol
description: The beloved Christmas tale by Charles Dickens - retold and animated with the same classic holiday spirit. A Christmas Carol follows the journey of a heartless business man, Ebenezer Scrooge, and his inspirational self discovery towards love. When three vividly haunting spirits force Scrooge to examine his past, present and future, he discovers how fruitless his path in life has become and how it has greatly impacted the lives of others. Through compassion, hardship and generosity, he finally finds the true meaning of Christmas.

name: Peter Pan
description: Wendy is a simple girl on the cusp of adolescence who lives in a stately home in London. She delights in sharing the stories of a magical boy named Peter with her younger brothers, though her father chides that she is getting a bit old for that sort of nonsense. Nonetheless, she dreams of meeting Peter one day, and she is ecstatic when he appears and whisks the three of them off to Neverland. Life in Neverland isn't all fun and games, however. There's the dangerous pirate captain Hook to contend with, and he poses a grave threat to all island's children. There's also the fact that Wendy is beginning to get homesick, and Peter doesn't want her to leave - or to grow up.

name: Casa de mi Padre
description: The ranch in Mexico that Armando Alvarez has lived and worked on all his life, that once belonged to his father, is beginning to encounter financial difficulties. Just when things look like they couldn't get more bleak, Armando's younger brother Raul appears with his new fiance, Sonia. Raul is a successful business man and claims that he can make all of the ranch's troubles disappear by settling all of the debts incurred by their father. All seems well until something happens: Armando finds himself falling for Sonia. While Armando tries to hide his feelings for his brother's fiance, they discover that Raul may not be the successful business man he claimed to be. Everything begins to fall apart when the group finds themselves involved in a war with the Mighty Onza, Mexico's feared drug lord.

name: American Rust
description: Police Chief Del Harris is the top cop in a small Pennsylvania town that has seen better days. The glory of the steel mill days are gone. The people of Buell are on a constant downward slide. Harris brings a raft of his own problems to his new job. An Iraq War veteran, he suffers from PTSD. As a former big city detective in Pittsburg, Harris hoped police work in a small town would be a positive change. But Del soon finds out that murders happen in rural Pennsylvania too -- and it has it own share of lowlifes.

name: Invincible
description: Based upon a true story, a 30-year-old bartender overcomes overwhelming odds to gain a position playing professional football for the Philadelphia Eagles. Recently divorced with a series of unfortunate life-changing events, the bartender figures he has nothing to lose and attempts to make the team. To everyone's surprise, he earns an opportunity to make his dreams come true and play professionally with the Eagles new coach. Full of comedy, romance, and a healthy dose of hard work and determination this drama reminds everyone that dreams are worth fighting for and even the unthinkable sometimes happens when you are least expecting it.

name: Mama
description: After vanishing for five years following a horrific series of events, young Victoria and Lilly are miraculously located by their Uncle Lucas, abandoned, and feral. Lucas and his girlfriend Annabel take in the sisters and attempt to get them the help they need, but something has followed the girls to their new home. Something that protected and cared for them during those long years alone in the forest. An entity that hasn’t taken kindly to the interference of Lucas and Annabel. An entity that the girls seem unsettlingly loving and comfortable with … and can only describe as “Mama”.

name: Working Girl
description: Tess McGill is the typical blonde bombshell that stays in a menial secretarial position her entire life, according to her friends and family. Her intelligence and career dreams, however, have brought her under the wing of Katherine Parker. As a top executive, Katherine Parker runs a Wall Street firm with vigor and finesse. Tess is her secretary and initially feels comfortable sharing her ideas with Katherine. After a ski accident, Katherine must remain at home to recuperate. Tess, as the loyal worker, keeps Katherine's office running in the meantime. Tess finds documentation about Katherine stealing one of her shared ideas and realizes that she must make her move now. Taking on Katherine's persona, Tess dives into the business world and finds deceit, along with loyalty, in the strangest places.

name: F/X
description: Rollie Tyler is a master of special effects, a reputation he has earned while working on a series of low budget slasher films. His expertise brings him to the attention of the Department of Justice, who hires him to stage the murder of mob informant Nicholas DeFranco so he can enter the Witness Protection Program. The staged assassination appears to go flawlessly, but complications quickly ensue when an innocent bystander is killed by a rogue DOJ agent. Tyler find himself on the run the next morning when his girlfriend is killed by a sniper aiming for him. Working with the DOJ agent who hired him, Tyler attempts to uncover the truth about the murders, while also trying to outwit a New York city detective who is bent on finding DeFranco and charging him with murder.

name: Stir of Echoes
description: Tom is an average husband and father in a Chicago based neighborhood. He goes to work and spends time with his family. While at a party, he allows his wife’s sister to hypnotize him, and despite his disbelief in such things, it works. When he wakes, he starts seeing ghosts, and other strange visions. In time, he learns his son is experiencing the same thing, though his son seems much more open to these visions.

name: Empire
description: Empire is a family drama centered on the world of hip-hop. Diagnosed with a severe illness, rap mogul Lucious Lyon is forced to make the hard decision of which of his three sons will inherit his musical empire. The fight for power and money causes bitter rivalries and corrupt plotting that disrupt Lucious' family. The situation becomes even more complicated when his ex-wife decides to fight for his fortune. High drama ensues in this soap opera-like narrative. Amidst bitter jealousy, hatred and conniving schemes, Lucious is given the difficult task of finding the solution to fixing his already fractured family.

name: Mufasa: The Lion King
description: A prequel to Disney's 2019 film, \"The Lion King\".

name: Genius
description: What makes someone a genius? Many would define a genius as a person who is incredibly exceptional in one or more extraordinary ways. Does intelligence alone make someone a genius? What about creativity? What roles do genetics and childhood influences play? Does popularity have any impact? Are there more introvert or extrovert people who are defined by this term? Throughout human history, a wide range of people from diverse backgrounds have been called \"geniuses.\" Follow the lives of these rare people from birth to death, including their relationships, educations, loves, triumphs and even their failures, to learn more about what defines genius.

name: The Djinn
description: A young boy, Dylan Jacobs, suffers from asthma and the inability to speak. His mother dies in a horrifying way and leaves Dylan and his father, Michael, to start over again on their own. When Dylan and Michael move into a new home, Dylan discovers a book filled with spells that includes one for summoning an ancient wish-granting creature known as a Djinn. The book warns that the spell caster might lose their soul with their wish. Dylan uses the book to summon the creature without caring about the potential consequences. When he becomes trapped inside of the house without any hope of escape, Dylan realizes that he must banish the creature to survive. Yet, it knows every trick to manipulate people and convince them to allow it to stay.

name: Friendly Persuasion
description: Adapted from a novel by Jessamyn West, this drama focuses on the lives of the Birdwells, a Southern Indiana Quaker family whose members find themselves at odds with each other once Civil War breaks out. As the Confederate Army approaches their farm, the oldest son Josh breaks with the religious conviction of pacifism he grew up with by taking up his rifle in order to shoot at Army members, only to be injured himself in return. Every member of the Birdwell family must ultimately choose whether or not he can continue to remain pacifist or to engage in violent behavior to some degree in order to protect property as well as lives.

name: A Christmas Story 2
description: Ralphie, the bespectacled boy who was so intent on getting a bb gun for Christmas, is five years older now, and he has his sights set on a bigger prize. Now, only a car will be enough to make this young man happy. Of course, that's not going to be any easier to acquire than a gun, and many obstacles lie in his path on his quest to get what he wants. Little brother Randy and their parents are back as well, and each has his or her own struggles to deal with as the holidays approach. One of the most prominent is the effort of the Old Man to avoid having to pay for a turkey by catching fish for the family's Christmas dinner.

name: The Day
description: In a post-apocalyptic future, five people are struggling to survive and find basic shelter, food, and water. They come across what they thought was an abandoned farmhouse in which they plan to stay, rest, and regroup. Unfortunately for them, a gang of cannibal mutants is already hiding out in the house and has nefarious plans for their visitors. They accidentally set off a trap within the home. In the course of fighting, they discover that one of their own is also a mutant even as other members struggle to stay alive in the face of illness and injury.

name: SEAL Team
description: The Navy SEALs have always been known for their heroism, and this team is no exception. Tasked with some of the most difficult missions in the world, their lives are constantly on the line. In order to protect their unit-and their country-they are asked to complete daring physical feats that no on else in the world can possibly take on. However, sometimes their family lives can present an even bigger challenge than the missions that they are challenged with planning and executing.

name: The Deer Hunter
description: The Deer Hunter is about the effects of war on the American working class set in a small town. The movie opens with Michael and his friend Nick, attending a friend's wedding. They decide to go on one last deer hunting trip before they leave for Vietnam. Michael teaches Nick how to kill a deer with one shot, and to appreciate the beauty of nature. The men are later captured by the Vietcong and forced to play Russian roulette. Mike and Nick escape using the game to their advantage. However, they are severely affected by the effects of the capture and the war. Mike returns home alone and finds comfort with Nick's ex-girlfriend Linda. Mike returns to the war to try to find his friends Stan and Nick.

name: Meet the Browns
description: This series focuses on a family of senior citizens all trying to live together under one roof. Mr. Brown, the main protagonist, believes this was his father's last wish. He and his daughter Cora are the heads of the household. The show is modeled after the play and film versions and filled with the misadventures of the numerous generations of the Brown family of the suburbs. Mr. Brown and his daughter work at the school where some episodes take place. Other locations that are featured include the dining room, living room and kitchen of the two-story Brown Meadows Home. Mr. Brown’s room and Brianna’s room are also shown on occasion as is the outside patio. Life lessons are learned and laughter is shared as the residents all learn to live and love together.

name: Top Gun
description: The action classic \"Top Gun\" focuses on hot-shot aspiring fighter pilot Maverick, who is determined to carry on the legacy of his deceased father. Played by Tom Cruise, Maverick has a chip on his shoulder and only lets his guard down with his goofy best friend Goose (Anthony Edwards). When he finds himself falling for a female flight instructor (Kelly McGillis), it's just the beginning of his troubles in this romantic drama that brought the world the love theme \"Take My Breath Away\" and Meg Ryan's first big role. While the film does not always portray life as a fighter pilot in the most accurate way, its beautifully filmed aerial maneuvers have served as a major recruiting tool for the aviation branches of the military.

name: Still Waiting...
description: The crew at the restaurant Shenanigan's are under a lot of stress. The new restaurant, Ta-Ta's is drawing their customers and waitresses away with skimpy outfits and higher tips respectfully. When the manager at Shenanigan's finds out that he will be promoted to district manager if he can manage to have a $9000 day, he hatches a plan to raise sales at his restaurant. He tell his staff that if they don't hit the $9000 in sales that day, the store will close. The remaining staff hustle to raise the sales in fear for their jobs.

name: The Banishing
description: Dark secrets begin to reveal themselves when a reverend, Linus, moves his family into an English rectory with a terrifying hidden past. Linus and Marianne's already strained marriage turns dangerous when a stranger, Harry, enters their lives. Harry has mysterious knowledge of long-kept secrets about the couple's young daughter, Adelaide. As more dangerous secrets are revealed, Harry pleads with Marianne to take her daughter and flee the rectory in fear for their lives. Her worst fears are realized when she finds her daughter missing and must confront the supernatural forces that have been holding the rectory hostage.

name: Striking Distance
description: The gritty reality of living and working in a big city with steel manufacturing and coal mining at its roots permeates this police thriller. Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania has three rivers running through it that meet at Point State Park. Law enforcement in this city includes River Police who patrol the area in boats. When Detective Tom Hardy thinks a serial killer is a police officer, it causes him to get knocked down in the ranks to river patrolman. However, the killer clearly has plans to include Tom when the body of one of Tom's former girlfriends is found dumped in one of the rivers he patrols. Though demoted, Detective Harding uses his new position to search for the killer.

name: Final Analysis
description: Dr. Barr, a psychiatrist finds love in all the wrong places when he falls for the sister of a patient, who happens to be married to a member of the Greek mafia. The mobster’s overzealous jealousy and cruelty towards his wife leads Barr to convince the woman to file for divorce. But her fear of what her husband might do leads her to drink and an underlying medical condition causes her to launch an attack on her husband. Using his professional knowledge, Barr comes to her aid and tries to save her from facing the consequences, but he soon finds out, all may not be what he thinks; and he finds himself wondering whether or not he is fighting on the right side.

name: The Daughter
description: Returning to a logging town that has seen better days, a man attempts to make amends for the way he has treated the people in his life. However, the ghosts of the past are stronger than they seem at first. Although the trip home is ostensibly to attend his father's wedding to a much younger woman, it seems as if secrets are swirling around at every turn. And it seems as if these secrets have the chance to destroy the carefully constructed reality of every person present.

name: Madame Web
description: Madame Web is a clairvoyant whose psychic abilities allow her to see within the Spider-Verse itself.

name: Death of a Nation
description: History will always repeat itself if those in power don't learn from their mistakes, and here is further proof of that adage in the form of a political documentary. There are plenty of parallels to draw between the elections of 1860 and 2016 if one looks close enough. The results are controversial and the divide they cause is also incendiary. Their parallels will be examined in full under a magnifying glass, drawing worrying conclusions about the current state of this country, and a terrifying vision of the future.

name: Elsa & Fred
description: Fred's domineering daughter has talked him into selling his huge home. He's alone now and doesn't need all the room. Fred doesn't care where he is since he's realized that his life has been quite disappointing. It causes him to become depressed. He sleeps most of his day, or otherwise bemoans the years spent with a woman he hated, and in a job that didn't mean anything. Elsa lives in Fred's new building. She's decided that she would like to spend time with Fred although he has no desire to start a friendship with anyone. Elsa inches her way into Fred's life and changes his whole outlook on life.

name: Cool World
description: Jack Deeds is a cartoonist serving a prison sentence for murdering his wife's lover. Deeds keeps himself occupied by creating a comic book called Cool World. After getting out of prison Deeds is mysteriously drawn into Cool World by one of his creations, the voluptuous Holli Would. Holli plans to have sex with Deeds, knowing that if a cartoon, called a doodle, has sex with a human, called a noid, the cartoon will be come a human. But it can also bring devastating consequences for both Cool World and the real world. Holli eventually seduces Deeds, but both soon begin to feel the effects of their actions. They must take part in a desperate struggle to save the two worlds before it's too late.

name: The Keeping Room
description: The end of the Civil War is fast approaching. The South is on the run and the Union and gaining ground at a breakneck pace. For those in the line of the Union army it is a scary time indeed. Fearing the wrath of the coming army, three women, two sisters and a slave, have no one left to call on and must band together to defend their home from a rogue band of Union soldiers.

name: Blow Out
description: Movie sound technician, Jack Terry, must create realistic sounds for his current project, a low-budget thriller. In particular, the producer wants good quality screaming. Jack takes his equipment and hits the streets to record various sounds. Suddenly, he sees a car plunge into a creek. Jack rescues a young woman from the sinking car. While at the hospital he discover the dead driver was the governor. The rescued woman is an escort named Sally. The governor's people want Jack to keep quiet about Sally's involvement in the accident. Jack realizes that he recorded sounds of the accident. He clearly hears a gunshot, which blew out the car's tires. He now knows the governor was murdered. He decides to uncover the plot despite the dangers.

name: Young Einstein
description: A youthful Albert Einstein is growing up on his family's apple farm in Tasmania, preoccupied with music and science. His father brews his own beer, but is unable top things off with a good, foamy head. Albert sets out to solve the problem. His forceful attempt to split the beer atom and produce bubbles has explosive consequences, but also gives him the opportunity to travel to Australia to put a patent on his new discovery. During his travels he meets a pretty French scientist, Marie Curie, but also makes a few enemies who are determined to use his beer atom-splitting formula for their own benefit. Albert must protect his discovery, which could destroy the world if left in the wrong hands.

name: Heist
description: A gang of jewelry thieves known for pulling off complex heists takes it up a notch and through many twists and turns of the plot to keep viewers on edge. After the fence stiffs everyone else from the profits of a jewelry robbery, the gang gets word of a shipment of Swiss gold. Nobody trusts anybody, which leads to backstabbing, unexpected alliances, and plenty of mischief between family members, lovers, and friends alike. Double crosses are common, with double crossing of a double cross. One blink of the eyes can quickly lead to plot confusion.

name: African Cats
description: The lives of two families of large cats on the vast plains of Kenya are chronicled. A pride of lions and a coalition of cheetahs struggle to survive on grassland territory naturally divided by a river. As the seasons change, fluctuations in the water level of the river affect territorial relationships between the cats and other animals. A lion mother prepares her one cub to eventually survive on its own, and a cheetah mother of five cubs is able to eventually see three of them reach adulthood. The male pride leader is driven from power as the water level drops, allowing the arrival of rivals. Water crocodiles and ruthless hyenas present ongoing challenges to cubs, and the cats demonstrate abilities to nurture family relationships.

name: The House I Live In
description: For years, the drug enforcement policies of the United States government have come under scrutiny from journalists and news outlets all over the country. Instead of letting the media tell the story, it is about time that the people involved in the war on drugs tell their side of the tale. This is the real story of the war on drugs as told by convicted drug felons, district attorneys, wardens, other prison inmates, police officers, and federal drug enforcement officials. It is an intense look at how the policies that are intended to protect the public from drugs are affecting life in the prisons of the United States, and life in the cities as well.

name: Plush
description: Hayley is a musician by trade and she lives her life through her songs. She is starting to enjoy the benefits of a successful career when she starts to make decisions that will affect the rest of her life. Even though Hayley is married, she decides to fall in love with her new guitarist. She seems to have no regret for the effect that her decision is having on her husband and the rest of her family. But when Hayley's guitarist starts to display some of the dark traits that have caused him problems in the past, she starts to question her decisions. Her guitarist has a closet full of skeletons that could wind up becoming the thing that undoes her career and her life.

name: Their Finest
description: Set in 1940 in London, a screenwriter named Catrin assembles a cast and crew to produce an inspirational film that will lift the country's morale and motivate the U.S. to join the war effort against Hitler. She teams with Buckley, a fellow screenwriter, and gregarious actor Ambrose Hillard. The three work under fire to make a film that will make a difference for their country and the world. Based on the novel by Lissa Evans, Their Finest is a depiction of a young woman's journey to express herself and find her place during an era of intense international turmoil.

name: The Beatles: Eight Days a Week
description: The Beatles only toured for a few years. In that time, they played to crowds all over the world and changed the way musicians would hit the road for future concerts. Their time as a touring band would come to a screeching halt after one especially grueling tour. Archival footage as well as new interviews with living members reveal the trials and tribulations of being a famous band. Previously unseen footage from their now famous Shea Stadium show is also included.

name: Antz
description: Antz is an animated movie that follows the adventure of Z, an ant in a large colony in Central Park. Z longs for autonomy and questions why his every act must be done for the colony. He develops feelings for Princess Bala, who is trying to escape the confines of her royal life. Z trades places with a warrior ant, Weaver, in order to see Bala again. Eventually he and Bela find the legendary Insectopedia, which turns out to be a landfill. Warrior ants find them and forcibly take Bela back to the colony, and Z stages a daring rescue. He then discovers that the warriors are planning on killing the Queen and building a new colony where the weak are not allowed. He rescues the Queen and the worker ants and is almost killed. However, Princess Bela brings him back to life. Z and Bela get married and change the colony into a place where the individual is honored and respected.

name: The Order
description: As baffled law enforcement scrambles for answers about a series of increasingly violent bank robberies, counterfeiting operations, and armored car heists through the Pacific Northwest in 1983, a lone FBI agent stationed in the sleepy, picturesque Idaho town of Coeur d'Alene comes to believe the crimes are not the work of traditional, financially motivated criminals, but a group of dangerous domestic terrorists inspired by a radical, charismatic leader plotting a devastating war against the United States government.

name: The Punisher
description: Highly successful undercover agent Frank Castle has decided to retire and start over a new life with his wife and son. When the son of ruthless criminal Howard Saint is killed during Castle's last mission, Saint decides he also wants to see Castle retired...permanently. While on a family reunion holiday in Puerto Rico, Saint's attack squad mows down every member of Castle's family and leaves him for dead. A local witch doctor saves Castle's life, but months later he learns that Saint was never brought to justice. Donning a black t-shirt his son gave him that depicts a skull symbol designed to ward off evil, Castle decides to do more than bring justice to Saint and his organization. He decides to punish them.
